courier.label: Courier news on his order page
courier.help: Off by default. On, his order page also says what the courier last told us: out for delivery, and (with "Problems too") a delivery try that failed or an address the rider could not find, with "we are checking with the courier" for a lost or damaged parcel. The order's own steps show either way.

truthCheck.label: True-delivery check
truthCheck.help: Off by default. On, a parcel the courier marks "Delivered" while our own records say it came back (the courier collected only the delivery charge on a cash-on-delivery parcel, the door record says returned, the courier's statement, or the parcel was received back at the shop) opens a check for a person to resolve: really delivered, came back with the charge paid, or came back. "Hold the order" keeps the order from being marked delivered while the check is open. "Look back" is how many days after delivery a late sign still opens a check. Nothing here moves money or changes COD.
